Zj.bar_b_note: Large readable creatures carry it, but a top-down camera on a uniform noisy grass carpet with no sky, fog or light direction, plus cotton-ball smoke whiting out f02-f04, sinks it below Palworld/Valheim finish.

Wq.bar_b_note: The gold spider reads, but the brown dirt floor, missing purple storm sky and lightning, flat magenta telegraph rings, an invisible player creature and debug-heavy HUD panels sink it.

Xf.bar_b_note: The appealing, clearly built old villager with a readable face would sit in a Palworld-class game, but on a void background there is no light or atmosphere to show it at the same finish.

Om.bar_b_note: A's steady framing reads, but full-frame white puff spam (A f22-f23, f31-f32) and B's hillside camera that buries the player's boar in a mud pit behind oversized grass sink it.

Cm.bar_b_note: B's clear two-creature framing and rearing badger at f11 help, but flat ungraded light, a carpet of noisy grass and A's cropped badger with a tiny boar in a mud pit keep it short of the same finish.

Nq.bar_b_note: A's site stories (freed captive in row 2, banner and tent removed) carry some intent, but smeared low-res ground textures, flat tiled stone walls, a pale flat sky and repeated emblem-stone solutions sink it.

Vp.bar_b_note: B's naturalistic fur gets near the owner bar while A's glossy terracotta-clay body with moss decals reads as a toy, and neither boar stands taller than the 1.80 m trainer.

Th.bar_b_note: B's impact burst with the badger's head snapping up (f24) reads, but A's camera parked behind a wooden banner post for f18-f28 and the flat grass-only frames sink it.

top_changes.change: Combat camera and VFX: keep the production camera clear of props and slopes and framed on both fighters (no foreground posts, no buried mud-pit views, no camera inside canopy as in Wq B i12-i15); replace the screen-filling white cotton-ball puffs and flat magenta telegraph rings with small grounded dust, stone and lightning impacts.

Author real hit, stagger, dodge and faint body animation for the boar, badger and spider (flinch, recoil, lean, a readable grounded fall) so hurt frames leave the idle silhouette, and scale every creature taller than the 1.80 m trainer.

World grade: break the uniform noisy grass carpet into groves, paths and clearings, replace the smeared Nq ground textures, show sky with fog depth and directional light in fights, give Stormwood its purple storm sky, blue-green moss and lightning, and shrink the Wq debug HUD panels.
